name: freqtrade SampleStrategy
translation_notes: Long side only (the template's short rules dropped: spot long/flat engine). Entry: RSI(14) crosses above 30 while TEMA(9) is at or below the Bollinger(20, 2) middle band and rising versus the previous bar. Exit: RSI(14) crosses above 70 while TEMA(9) is above the middle band and falling. TEMA is not in the registry, so EMA(9) stands in for it. Bollinger bands use close here; freqtrade's template uses typical price (H+L+C)/3. The ROI table (0 min: 4%, 30 min: 2%, 60 min: 1%) becomes a single 4% take-profit, because time-decaying ROI has no registry equivalent. Stop-loss 10% kept. The template's volume > 0 guard is implicit (zero-volume bars are untradable in the lab). Timeframe changed 5m -> 1h (5m archive data is not kept for research).

plan.name: seed_freqtrade_sample_strategy
plan.description: Calibration seed translated from freqtrade's SampleStrategy template (long side). Popular published strategy; expected to fail honest testing.
plan.long_entry: crosses_above(rsi, 30) and tema_proxy <= bb.mid and tema_proxy > prev(tema_proxy, 1)
plan.long_exit: crosses_above(rsi, 70) and tema_proxy > bb.mid and tema_proxy < prev(tema_proxy, 1)
